inventoryStatuses.name: Consignment
inventoryStatuses.message: Consigned inventory may not be merged, split, or consumed. First the consignment flag must be removed from the inventory by creating a consignment usage transaction.

inventoryStatuses.name: Picked
inventoryStatuses.message: THIS INVENTORY HAS BEEN PICKED AS PART OF A STAGING PROCESS, IN ORDER TO MANIPULATE THIS INVENTORY - IT MUST BE REMOVED FROM THE PICK PROCESS.

inventoryStatuses.name: Production Loaded
inventoryStatuses.message: THIS STATUS REPRESENTS THE CURRENT STATE OF THE INVENTORY IS LOADED TO A PRODUCTION WORK CENTER FOR PURPOSE OF CONSUMCustomer-DON BY A PRODUCTION SETUP - IN ORDER TO MODIFY THIS INVENTORY - IT MUST FIRST BE UNLOADED FROM THE PRODUCTION WORK CENTER.

inventoryStatuses.name: QC (Hold)
inventoryStatuses.message: Inventory on QC Hold - should not be used in Production and can not be shipped.

inventoryStatuses.name: Receiving (Hold)
inventoryStatuses.message: THIS INVENTORY WAS PLACED ON HOLD AS PART OF THE RECEIVING PROCESS FROM OUTSIDE, THIS CAN ONLY BE RELEASED BY SOMEONE WITH PROPER SYSTEM ACCESS - TYPICALLY QUALITY.

inventoryStatuses.name: Scrap
inventoryStatuses.message: THIS INVENTORY HAS BEEN SCRAPPED EITHER BY THE CONTROL PANEL OR SOME OTHER INVENTORY SCRAP FUNCTION. DO NOT MODIFY THIS INVENTORY OR REPORTING ERRORS WILL OCCUR. IF THIS WAS SCRAPPED IN ERROR - CREATE NEW INVENTORY - MAKE AN ADJUSTMENT.

inventoryStatuses.name: Sent To OSP
inventoryStatuses.message: THIS INVENTORY HAS BEEN SHIPPED TO OSP. VARIOUS ERRORS MAY OCCUR IF CHANGES ARE MADE TO THIS INVENTORY OUTSIDE OF THE OSP PROCESSING.

inventoryStatuses.name: Shipped
inventoryStatuses.message: THIS INVENTORY HAS BEEN SHIPPED AND CAN NOT BE MANIPULATED. VARIOUS ERRORS MAY OCCUR IF CHANGES ARE MADE TO THIS INVENTORY POST SHIPMENT UNLESS THE ENTIRE SHIPMENT IS UNWOUND.

inventoryStatuses.name: Staged
inventoryStatuses.message: THIS INVENTORY HAS BEEN STAGED TO A SHIPMENT AND CAN NOT BE MANIPULATED. VARIOUS ERRORS MAY OCCUR IF CHANGES ARE MADE TO THIS INVENTORY UNLESS IT IS UNSTAGED FROM THE SHIPMENT.

data.messageTransform: "An unexpected error occurred, please review data flow logs for further details"
